model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the perceived readiness of contractors and designers to implement projects according to the Passive House standard, segmented into four categories. The largest segment, colored green and representing 51%, indicates that only a small portion of contractors/designers are prepared to execute such projects, though many specialists require training. Two equal-sized segments, each at 23%, show contrasting views: one (purple) suggests that contractors/designers are well-prepared and qualified, while the other (red) states that only part of them are ready. The smallest segment, in blue (3%), reflects the opinion that there are not enough qualified specialists to build Passive House-standard buildings. The chart includes a legend on the right, with each category clearly labeled in Bulgarian, and percentage values are displayed directly inside each slice for clarity.
